title: KCP assistant_list result (DESIGN.md §10.5, §11.6.1 assistant author/deploy family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for assistant_list (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). §11.5 page of AssistantDefinition projections (gap notes KG4/KG9). §11.5 page shape verbatim: { items[], next?, snapshot, boundary_event_cursor }. The first page creates a stable snapshot token (expiry >= 15 minutes); further pages see the same logical boundary or return snapshot-expired; authorization is rechecked for every page (gap note KG9).

items.description: Page of AssistantDefinition projections; at most 512 items (§11.8 page read limit).

assistantDefinition.description: AssistantDefinition projection, field names verbatim from the §10.5 record shape (gap notes KG4/KG6).

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).

displayName.description: Display name bounded by the §11.8 cap of 256 Unicode scalar values, length-bounded again at admission.

freeText.description: Bounded free text. §11.8 bounds free text again at admission; the 4096-scalar schema ceiling is the recorded extraction bound (ops README gap note KG8).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

statusToken.description: Lifecycle status token. DESIGN.md §10.5 names these status fields without pinning a value space; the bounded lowercase token pins the shape without inventing an enum (gap note KG6).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
